And it detected the incorrect character in the correct line

I also tested with
```
[gd_scene format=3 uid="uid://dxm30rnsk76so"]

[sub_resource type="GDScript" id="GDScript_7dm0k"]
script/source = "@tool
extends Node

@export var number_count = 3:
	set(nc):
		number_count = nc
		numbers.resize(number_count)
		notify_property_list_changed()

var numbers = PackedInt32Array([0, 0, 0])

func _get_property_list():
	var properties: Array[Dictionary] = []

	for i in range(number_count):
		properties.append({
			\"name\": \"number\\n%d\" % i,
			\"type\": TYPE_INT,
		})

	return properties

func _get(property):
	if property.begins_with(\"number\\n\"):
		var index = property.get_slice(\"_\", 1).to_int()
		return numbers[index]
	return null

func _set(property, value):
	if property.begins_with(\"number\\n\"):
		var index = property.get_slice(\"_\", 1).to_int()
		numbers[index] = value
		return true
	return false
"

[node name="Node" type="Node" unique_id=1528113561]

[node name="Node" type="Node" parent="." unique_id=794826478]
script = SubResource("GDScript_7dm0k")
"number
0" = 1
"number
1" = 2
"number
2" = 3
```
And the properties that have multi-line are still functional, tested around with full projects and they seem to function fine.
